# netactuate_cloud_routing_meshes (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Routing Meshes visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_routing_meshes" "example" {
}
```

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `meshes` (List of Object) Magic meshes visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meshes))
